intent-operations.title: Intelligent input
intent-operations.intro: Describe your goal, review an editable plan, then preview and save drafts in this project.
intent-operations.workspace_hint: Review requirement, design and knowledge drafts in one plan.
intent-operations.goal: What would you like to achieve?
intent-operations.goal_hint: Describe the outcome and acceptance criteria. Add project sources only when needed.
intent-operations.context_hint: Select authorized project records. Their versions are fixed when planning starts. You can start without extra sources.
intent-operations.no_sources: No records are available in this scope.
intent-operations.no_profile: This project has no enabled, freshly observed read-only profile for intelligent input.
intent-operations.not_health: Profile eligibility is confirmed, not verified account health or a successful model call.
intent-operations.model_ack: I agree to send this goal and selected sources to the fixed model within this output budget.
intent-operations.restore_hint: The outcome is unconfirmed. Recover the original request and receipt before making another change.
intent-operations.saved: The plan is saved and ready for review.
intent-operations.applied: All drafts were saved as previewed.
intent-operations.basis_changed: A fixed source has changed. Review the current basis before applying this plan.
intent-operations.usage_hint: Token usage and cost come from actual run records. Unreported values remain unknown.
intent-operations.goal_only: This plan uses the submitted goal without additional project sources.
intent-operations.questions_hint: One question per line. Resolve the required information and revise the plan before applying it.
intent-operations.invalid_json: The JSON structure is incomplete. Your exact edit is preserved; correct it to continue.
intent-operations.invalid_proposal: Check required fields, limits, dependencies and source references before saving these edits.
intent-operations.version_changed: The service version has changed. Keep your edits and explicitly review the new version before saving.
intent-operations.default_reason: Reviewed this draft plan and its impact.
intent-operations.atomic_hint: All drafts are saved in one transaction. If any step fails, none are saved. Publication, task adoption and execution retain their formal workflows.
intent-operations.preview_blocked: This preview cannot be applied. Resolve open questions, changed sources or permission limits, then preview again.
intent-operations.drafts_ack: I have reviewed every step, reference and default and agree to save these drafts as previewed.
intent-operations.result_hint: These are the immutable save receipts for this operation. They do not represent design publication, task execution or human acceptance.
intent-operations.empty_hint: For example: create requirement and design drafts for order export with acceptance criteria.
intent-operations.one_per_line: One criterion per line. Keep each criterion complete.
intent-operations.choose_requirement: Choose a source requirement or an earlier creation step
intent-operations.task_draft_hint: Tasks remain in the design draft and are created through the formal publication and adoption preview workflow.
intent-operations.original_unavailable: No original model output has been received.
intent-operations.invalid_read: The service did not return a confirmed current plan. Retry explicitly.
intent-operations.refresh_failed: The saved facts are retained, but the view did not refresh. Refresh explicitly to inspect the current state.
intent-operations.access_changed: Current access has changed. Check your session and project permissions, then retry.
intent-operations.reason.basis_changed: A fixed source has changed. Generate a new plan from the current sources.
intent-operations.reason.output_invalid: The model output does not satisfy the local draft plan structure. Inspect the retained original output.
intent-operations.reason.execution_faile: The planning run did not complete successfully. Inspect the actual run record.
intent-operations.reason.execution_unkno: The model execution outcome is unconfirmed. Reconcile the original run first.
intent-operations.default_source.local_d: Source: the fixed local draft policy
intent-operations.setup_install: Use the suma-agent entry built from this project and prepare its fixed model configuration.
intent-operations.setup_configure: Save this read-only configuration on the runner; inject its key through SUMA_MODEL_API_KEY.
intent-operations.setup_register: Report the observed capability, then have an administrator register and enable its profile and configure the budget.
intent-operations.setup_policy: Proposes only requirement, design and knowledge drafts using one model call without tools or workspace access. Drafts are saved after explicit preview confirmation. Discovery does not verify model service or account access.
